page.title: Ba connecteurs ya ba connecteurs
page.intro: Bokanga ba comptes na bino ya publicité. Ba leads oyo ewutaka na ba publicités na yo ekomaka na My Leads automatiquement, na dépense na coût par lead.

catalog.linkedinDescription: Lead Gen Form ememaka na My Leads, mokolo na mokolo dépense mpe coût par lead, mpe qualité ya lead etindami lisusu na LinkedIn ( Conversions API ).

banner.connected: LinkedIn ekangami. Ba leads ezali kozuama sikoyo - page oyo ezo mettre à jour na moment moko.
banner.notConfigured: LinkedIn esalemi nanu na serveur oyo te. Mokambi asengeli kobakisa ID ya client mpe sekele ya appli LinkedIn .

connect.title: Bozala na boyokani LinkedIn
connect.intro: Kota na compte LinkedIn oyo etambwisaka ba piblisite na yo. Leadrat etangaka kaka ba comptes ya ba publicités na yo, ba leads Lead Gen Form na ba statistiques ya ba publicités, pe etindi ba conversions oyo ofungolaka.
connect.need1: Role moko na compte ya publicité LinkedIn (Motali to koleka).
connect.need2: Role moko na page ya entreprise oyo ezali na lien (Administrateur, Lead Gen Forms Manager , Content Admin , Curator to Analyst) - LinkedIn esengaka yango ekabola ba leads.
connect.need3: Motuna ya nimero ya telefone na Lead Gen Forms - ba leads oyo ezangi numéro ya téléphone ekoki kobakisa te.

connection.fetchTitle: Bozwa ba leads na date range
connection.fetchHint: Ba leads ya sika e vérifier chaque quelques minutes et 7 jours ya suka ezo vérifier mikolo nionso, donc eloko moko te ezanga. Salelá yango mpo na ba leads oyo euti liboso ya ko connecter, to mpo na kotala lisusu période moko (kino mikolo 90 na mbala moko). Ba leads déjà na Leadrat ezo sauter.

capi.title: Conversions API
capi.intro: Yebisa LinkedIn oyo ya ba leads na yango ekomaki ba vrais perspectives. Tango lead LinkedIn akomi na statut oyo oponi na se, Leadrat eyebisi yango na LinkedIn , yango wana ba rapports ya campagne na yo elakisaka qualité ya lead mpe LinkedIn ekoki kozwa bato mingi lokola ba leads na yo ya malamu. Kaka ID ya liboso ya LinkedIn mpe hash ya nzela moko ya email nde etindamaka.
capi.noRules: Status moko te esalemi naino na carte.
capi.created: Conversion esalemi na LinkedIn mpe esalemi na carte.
